description: A single line drawn as steps, holding each value until the next reading.
overview: One series with `type="step"`, which draws flat runs and vertical jumps instead of slopes. Use it for values that change at discrete moments. It has a month axis, a dashed grid and a tooltip.
usage: Replace `chartData` with your records and change each `dataKey` to match your fields. Set the label and color in `chartConfig`. The component takes no props.
